heading: Policies and methods
lead: Subject to section 523 of this title, in order to minimize expenditures for property, the Administrator of General Services shall—

tree.text: prescribe policies and methods to promote the maximum use of excess property by executive agencies; and
provide for the transfer of excess property—

children.text: to the organizations specified in section 321(c)(2) of this title.

A, title X, § 1056(a)(6), Jan. 6, 2006, 119 Stat. 3439, provided that: “(a) Transfer of Excess Real Property.—(1) Except as provided in subsection (d), before screening excess real property located on Guam for further Federal utilization under section 202 [now 40 U.S.C. 521 et seq.] of the Federal Property and Administrative Services Act of 1949 (40 U.S.C. 471 et seq.) [now 40 U.S.C. 101 et seq.] (hereinafter the ‘Property Act’), the Administrator shall notify the Government of Guam that the property is available for transfer pursuant to this section. “(2) If the Government of Guam, within 180 days after receiving notification under paragraph (1), notifies the Administrator that the Government of Guam intends to acquire the property under this section, the Administrator shall transfer such property in accordance with subsection (b).
